issues.description: Animal.name type requirement is inconsistent: the problem statement explicitly instructs students to use a StringBuilder for the Animal name attribute, but the UML diagram specifies name: String and the reference solution implements `private String name;` with `getName(): String` and `setName(String)`. This creates conflicting expectations for the field type and accessor signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts on one design. Recommended: change the problem statement to require `String name` (remove the StringBuilder instruction) to match UML and solution. Alternatively, update UML and solution to store `StringBuilder name` and adjust accessor expectations consistently (e.g., keep internal StringBuilder but expose `String getName()` and `void setName(String)` if tests expect String).
